description: Trafiknätsdata för blåljusverksamheten is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. The data product Traffic network data for blue light operations consists of selected phenomena and attributes from the Swedish Transport Administration's open database for road and rail. The selection has been based on a list of common specified data for the blue light actors produced by the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MSB). Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic network data for blue light operations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Datapaket och specialprodukter, Data packages and special products. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
